comparison.objective: Disinfect an IV connector for 15 seconds before attaching and flushing a syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed frictional scrubbing, sterile sequencing, precise luer alignment, and plunger control.
comparison.success_condition: Hub scrubbed before any syringe contact, syringe seated, and prescribed flush volume collected without loss or contamination.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered clinical surface preparation and fluid-line access, not loose-body separation.
